overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures premium spray dried garlic powder for global food processing. Sourced from selected raw garlic bulbs in India, our product undergoes precision spray drying to preserve its natural pungent aroma and volatile oils. The resulting 80 mesh powder offers exceptional solubility and rapid dispersion without clumping, ensuring uniform flavor distribution across commercial food production lines.

As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we adhere to a disciplined six-step production process. This process includes sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch. With moisture maintained below five percent and an eighteen to twenty-four month shelf life, our garlic powder delivers industrial consistency and reliable performance for high-volume commercial manufacturing applications.
highlights: Extended shelf life of 18 to 24 months
Preserves pungent aroma and natural volatile oils
Free from added fillers and artificial additives
packaging: Custom private label pouches and jars

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried garlic powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, accommodating small pilot testing as well as large industrial orders.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk and retail orders?
faqs.a: We supply 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and custom private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM manufacturing, private labeling, and custom mesh sizes upon request.

faqs.q: Can I request a sample prior to placing an industrial order?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request to assist with formulation testing and quality evaluation.

faqs.q: What manufacturing procedure ensures product uniformity?
faqs.a: We operate a six-step process covering sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide documentation support for international shipments?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and complete batch traceability.
